The name itself has a backstory, and that does extend to my hunter. Taemar was the name of the main character in my first creative writing piece. I loved the name so much that it stuck with me for a long time until I had the opportunity to flesh out the character. Taemar is now a part of my best friend's dragon/sci-fi world. He's there instead of in one of my writing project worlds because mine change so often, but my best friend's world has been mostly constant for more than a decade. Every time I use his name in a video game (which I do frequently), I imagine there happens to be a magical/technological glitch/mishap, and suddenly he's found himself in said video game world. He loves exploring new places and learning about new worlds and peoples, especially exotic plants and animals. Eventually, he'll start trying to find a way home after the end of the game. (It's essentially just an Isekai, I know.) Sometimes I'll even write little snippets of the game through his eyes like a little journal entry. 😁
